Class DamageCard

java.lang.Object
de.lmu.dbs.ifi.sep25.card.Card
de.lmu.dbs.ifi.sep25.card.DamageCard.DamageCard
All Implemented Interfaces:
RegisterCard, Cloneable
public class DamageCard extends Card implements RegisterCard
Represents a damage card that is executed during the robot’s register phase. There are four types of damage cards, each with a distinct in-game effect.

    • execute

      public void execute(Robot robot, Player player)
      Executes the effect of this damage card on the specified robot (and its player).
      • SPAM: Logs simple damage, no extra effect.
      • WORM: Logs and forces an immediate reboot via the board’s Reboot element.
      • VIRUS: Logs and calls spreadVirus(Robot) to give SPAM cards to nearby robots.
      • TROJAN_HORSE: Logs and grants the robot two additional SPAM damage cards.
      After executing the effect, this card is removed and replaced in the robot’s damage deck.
      Specified by:
      execute in interface RegisterCard
      Specified by:
      execute in class Card
      Parameters:
      robot - the robot on which to execute this damage card
      player - the player who owns the robot (currently unused, reserved for UI/notifications)
